Nightmare
You lose [1]% Hit Points at the start of each turn. In a normal dream, a strong push from a friend would snap you out of it...
Unrecognized Deity

The ancient deity Kelcidon has awakened and hungers to prove his divinity! When you deal damage to Kelcidon, your entire party loses [1]% of their Maximum Hit Points. Prove that he is nothing but a worthless stray — push him, splash him, throw things at him, sic a dog on him. Then stop attacking and wait [2] turns!
Rising Superiority
Kelcidon increases his Saving Throws and Armour Class by [1] if he was not damaged last turn!
Supreme Deity

When a creature other than Kelcidon enters a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GlobeOfInvulnerability">Globe of Invulnerability</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Sanctuary">Sanctuary</LSTag>, it dies instantly.

Divine Awakening
Cat You Don't Mock

Warning: This creature guards something of immense value. Engaging it unprepared may end your adventures. Those who covet treasure should be wary — greed has ended many adventurers. Treats being pushed, splashed, or mocked like any common animal as the greatest insult.

We convinced Timber to let us walk on her territory. In gratitude, she gifted us a strange trinket she had dug up somewhere in the forest.
We saved Findal from goblin scouts. The grateful halfling pressed a magical trinket into our hands before hurrying away.
We saved the tiefling girl from the bugbear. In gratitude, she gifted us a family heirloom, passed down through generations.
We helped Alfira compose her song. The overjoyed bard pulled out an unusual artifact from her dress - something she had found on the road to the Grove.
We convinced Rolan and his kin to stay at the Grove. The renowned wizard discreetly slipped us a magical artifact from his collection.
We befriended the owlbear cub. While playing with it, we discovered a shiny trinket tangled in its feathers - a prize from some previous adventure.
We convinced Scratch to join our camp. The dog dug up something buried nearby and dropped it at our feet - an old magical trinket.
We won the chicken race at the goblin camp. One stunned goblin, having lost his bet, reluctantly pulled a magical bauble from his trophy stash.
We performed the ritual ceremony with Dror Razglin. In the chaos afterward, we noticed a strange artifact among the dead illithid's possessions.
We mediated the conflict between Aradin and Zevlor at the Grove gates. Seeking to ease tensions, Zevlor discreetly passed us a small artifact with a meaningful nod.
We poisoned the goblins' drinks. While looting the fallen, we found an unusual magical trinket among their spoils.
We placed flowers on the grave of the wizard's magical dog. As we paid our respects, a faint magical glow emanated from the earth, and an artifact materialized atop the burial mound.
We convinced the bandits to leave the Chapel. As they fled, one bandit dropped a small trinket. We wisely kept this discovery to ourselves.
We helped Stonemason Kith solve an archaeological mystery. Impressed by our insight, the duergar rewarded us with an artifact from his collection of ancient finds.
We stole the cursed monk's amulet from the lava-filled chamber without slaying the elemental guardian. The artifact itself seems to have accepted us as its new bearer.
We found all four merregon masks in Grymforge. Hidden beneath the last mask was a small cache - someone's secret stash, now ours to claim.
We freed the goblin heretic from his cage at the goblin camp. The grateful outcast pressed a magical trinket into our hands - his only possession of value.

We escaped the Hells on the nautiloid. Wandering the shore, we stumbled upon shattered containers filled with belongings confiscated from the illithids' former prisoners.
We surrendered Shadowheart to Viconia. We are now in alliance with Viconia. Viconia also offered a rich selection from her Sharran arsenal.
I placed the Crown of Karsus upon my head, becoming the God of Ambition. Enchanted artifacts suddenly rained down from the sky.
We escaped the Monastery's powerful trap with the Blood of Lathander in tow - but Crèche Y'llek was destroyed in the process. Suddenly, an item whistled past our ears, nearly cracking our skulls.
We brought the creature to the city as requested. Seems it left us a note and a small pouch as thanks.
We stopped Cora Highberry from drinking poisoned wine - saving her life. Overwhelmed with gratitude, she gifted us her family heirloom.
We told the rat that we would leave them alone. The rats returned the favor - a whole swarm carried a massive moss-covered artifact on their backs.

We helped the orthon break free from his contract - but it seems that Raphael had already planned for the outcome. A magical trinket suddenly slipped from Raphael's pocket as he vanished, and we decided such a thing shouldn't go to waste.

We did not commune with the Astral-Touched Tadpole, and our illithid potential remains untapped. Suddenly we spotted a dragon's silhouette, and a moment later a githyanki crate crashes down - filled with provisions and a reward for staying pure.

The allies we've made on our journey have all gathered together - ready to lend us their power in the battle ahead. It is time to finish this - once and for all. One of our allies prepared a special tool for us.
The now-sated mind flayer granted us a boon of psionic power and told us about a secret stash at the windmill.

We reached the peak of the shadow-cursed lands, rejecting fey support as heretical. The radiant visage of Selûne appears: "Child of light, you walked through shadow by strength of soul alone. Your resolve has triumphed where my sister's curse could not break you. Accept this divine boon - you have earned it."

We saved Zevlor, who explained that he let the Absolute infiltrate his mind. It's unlikely the tieflings will welcome him back - he'll have to forge his own path now. He pointed us to one of the pits he had noticed, where a brightly glowing item lay.

We successfully lifted the shadow curse. In time, these lands will flourish once again. Selûne's luminous form manifests before you: "My sister's shadow no longer taints these lands, thanks to you. They shall flourish once more under my light. Ask, child, and it shall be granted."
We left for Baldur's Gate without finding a way to lift the shadow curse. At least we found some valuable items along the way.

Halsin rescued Thaniel from the Shadowfell, but the spirit of the land is ill. Being quite resourceful, Halsin picked up some magical trinkets from the Shadowfell along the way and shared one with us.

Despite the Waveservants' anger at the Iron Throne's detonation and its pollution of the ocean, they rewarded us for dealing with Redhammer. However, we couldn't shake the feeling that the priestesses would have paid more had we brought the poacher in alive.
Rolan's family are finally safe, and together once more in Last Light. Red-faced from tears, Rolan gifts us his most precious relic - one he had been saving throughout the journey to show Lorroakan.
We helped Minthara escape Moonrise Towers. She went to our camp to recover from her ordeal. Grumbling, she shoved into our hands what she had managed to steal from the guards.
The drider made it to Moonrise Towers. To celebrate, Z'rell ordered one of the most valuable artifacts in the Towers' collection to be given to us.
Disciple Z'rell was pleased that we successfully captured both Nightsong and Isobel. She has granted us an audience with Ketheric Thorm on the roof of Moonrise - and a token of her appreciation.

Lucretious rewarded us with the greatest prize the circus had ever known, collecting a year's salary from every performer to afford such a treasure. She intends to raise Dribbles from the dead - with some improvements. The circus will soon leave Wyrm's Crossing.
We allowed the duergar to keep the deep gnomes as slaves. The grateful underdark raiders did not let this go unnoticed.
The tieflings and the druids were defeated. The grove has been destroyed. We managed to reach the grove's deepest vaults containing the druids' most precious relics.
Arabella is safe - her parents are grateful for our intervention. They pressed a trinket into our hands - something they had found on their way to the grove.
We persuaded Kagha to stop the ritual. In the heat of battle with the Shadow Druids, she tossed us an enchanted trinket.
The road is finally safe, and the tieflings have left for Baldur's Gate. Meanwhile, we received well-deserved rewards from the grove's inhabitants.

We've reached the crèche. Lae'zel says there should be some kind of device capable of removing the parasite. We just need to find it. Familiar with the logic of githyanki stashes, she quickly found one containing a valuable trinket.
While it wasn't a joyful reunion, Derryth has her husband back now. With visible contempt, she tossed something from her worn equipment onto the ground for us.

We told Derryth that her husband is dead. She didn't seem particularly upset. Barely containing her overwhelming euphoria, the merchant laid out her finest magical wares and offered us our pick of the best.
We made a deal with Auntie Ethel. She promised us power, tossed a fey relic and a strand of her hair onto the floor, then left - taking Mayrina with her.
We gave Nightsong to Lorroakan. Beside himself with joy, Lorroakan snapped his fingers without even looking at us, and the wizard's finest masterpieces materialized in the air before us.

Zarys rewarded us for bringing back the shipment. She forced a smile, but everyone in the camp looked at us with hostility for not keeping their comrades alive. It seems we could have received much more had we taken care to preserve the Zhentarim brotherhood's lives.

Zarys thanked us for defending her agents and bringing back the shipment. Though still coldly barking orders, she smirked at having kept both - and rewarded us with gifts from the Zhentarim's private collection.
Maneuver Save DC

The save DC for your maneuvers.

8 + Proficiency Bonus + STR or DEX mod (whichever is higher)

Some maneuvers have a hidden modifier (often tied to item rarity). Check the combat log for the actual DC.
Astarion's gone — vanished in the night. By the campfire, we found a worn leather pouch left behind by the monster hunter. Inside was a relic from his Gur travels — payment for our cooperation.
We found people taking refuge in a grove. We should explore it - there might be a healer inside. Suddenly, we noticed a shiny thing sticking out near the battle.

The hag's lair reeks of deceit no more. Choose your spoils — you've earned them.
The goblin throne lies empty. Claim what the fallen king could not protect.
The drow commander's ambitions end here. Her arsenal is yours for the taking.
The Absolute's priestess is silenced. Plunder what remains of her dark devotion.
The beholder's gaze is extinguished. Treasures once petrified in its lair now await a new owner.
The matriarch's web unravels. Her hoard, long wrapped in silk, is yours to claim.
The shadow druid's corruption is purged. Nature's balance yields a gift to those who restored it.
Myrkul's chosen has fallen at last. The Shadow Curse weakens — and power awaits those bold enough to claim it.
The tollmaster's greed has been her undoing. Her golden hoard scatters before you — take what you will.
The surgeon will operate no more. His instruments of torment hold power — for those with the stomach to wield them.
The last drink has been poured. The brewer's distillery yields its final, most potent concoction — for you.
The necromancer's dark research ends here. His arcane instruments now serve a worthier purpose.
The orthon's contract is void. Raphael's enforcer leaves behind spoils worthy of the Nine Hells.
Bhaal's blade is shattered. The Temple of Murder surrenders its relics to those who silenced the slaughter.
The tyrant of Wyrm's Rock is overthrown. His vault lies open — take what Bane's chosen hoarded for himself.
The devil's bargain is broken on your terms. The House of Hope yields its secrets to you.
The vampire lord's eternal rite is undone. Centuries of plundered wealth now pass to you.
The Throne of Blood stands empty once more. The Murder Tribunal's judgment falls in your favour.
The undead dragon's torment ends. Ansur's ancient hoard, guarded even in death, is finally free.
Shar's faithful lies broken. The House of Grief holds no more sorrow — only spoils for the victorious.
The archwizard's tower is yours to loot. His jealously guarded collection now belongs to those who bested him.

Commander Zhalk falls amid the nautiloid's dying screams. Even infernal might bows before those with nothing left to lose — claim the spoils of hell's finest.
The owlbear's fury is stilled forever. Even the fiercest predator meets its match — the cave yields its guardian's hoard to you.
The bulette's earth-rending hunger ends. From its torn shell, the deep gives up what it had hoarded under the dark.
The Inquisitor's judgment is overturned. He who sought heresy in others found his own doom — the creche's treasures are yours.
The shambling horror crumbles to rot and silence. The cursed earth reclaims its mindless servant — but not before yielding its spoils to you.
The Nightsong's radiance fades into the Shadowfell's embrace. Even immortal light can be extinguished — her divine relics now serve mortal hands.
The Morninglord's sacred mace blazes with undying light. Its ancient power shall be reshaped — choose the relic worthy of your crusade.
The Noblestalk's magic takes hold — Baelen's shattered mind begins to mend. A rare act of mercy in the Underdark does not go unnoticed.
Blood stains your hands and a dark gift awaits. The Butler's offering reeks of murder — its power shall be reshaped. Choose the relic worthy of your crimson path.

Critical Roast

DM Screen
Vludber controls the game. All attacks against him have Advantage, but his glamour blunts the blows that land. Critical failures still tear through — the Game Master decides what truly hurts.
